```{r}
auc_components_plot = function(plsmodel) {
  plsmodel$pred %>%
    separate(Resample, c("Fold", "Rep")) %>%
    group_by(ncomp, keepX, Rep) %>%
    summarize(auc = as.numeric(pROC::auc(predictor = pred, obs, direction = "<"))) %T>%
    { mx <<- max(.$auc); mn <<- min(.$auc) } %>%
    ggplot(., aes(x = factor(keepX), y = auc, fill=factor(ncomp))) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha=0.25) +
    geom_point(aes(color=factor(ncomp)),
               alpha=0.6,
               position=position_jitter(w=0.15, h=0)) +
    guides(fill="none", color="none") +
    facet_wrap(~ ncomp) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, lwd=.5, linetype=2) +
    scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1", name = NULL) +
    theme_bw() + theme(strip.background = element_blank()) +
    xlab("Number of features") + ylab("AUC")
}
get_loadings = function (trainobj, what = c("finalModel", "CV"), xykeep = c("x", 
                                                                            "y", "both"), rep = NA, remove_empty = TRUE, summarize = TRUE, 
                         ncomp = NA, keepX = NA, keepY = NA) 
{
  if (what[1] == "finalModel") {
    loadingsx <- trainobj$finalModel$loadings$X %>% data.frame %>% 
      mutate(var = rownames(.), sd = NA, chosen = NA) %>% 
      gather(comp, loading, -var, -sd)
    loadingsy <- trainobj$finalModel$loadings$Y %>% data.frame %>% 
      mutate(var = rownames(.), sd = NA, chosen = NA) %>% 
      gather(comp, loading, -var, -sd)
  }
  if (what[1] == "CV") {
    bt <- trainobj$bestTune
    if (!is.na(ncomp)) 
      bt$ncomp <- ncomp
    if (!is.na(keepX)) 
      bt$keepX <- keepX
    if (!is.na(keepY)) 
      bt$keepY <- keepY
    control <- trainobj$control
    keep <- rep(TRUE, length(control$index))
    if (!is.na(rep)) 
      keep <- grepl(rep, names(control$index))
    index <- control$index[keep]
    indexOut <- control$indexOut[keep]
    seeds <- control$seeds[keep]
    refits <- lapply(seq(along = index), function(i) {
      trainobj$modelInfo$fit(trainobj$finalModel$X[index[[i]],],
                             trainobj$finalModel$Y[index[[i]], ],
                             param = bt, 
                             trainobj$dots)
    })
    loadingsx <- lapply(seq_along(refits), function(i) {
      refits[[i]]$loadings$X %>% data.frame %>% mutate(var = rownames(.)) %>% 
        gather(comp, loading, -var)
    }) %>% bind_rows
    loadingsy <- lapply(seq_along(refits), function(i) {
      refits[[i]]$loadings$Y %>% data.frame %>% mutate(var = rownames(.)) %>% 
        gather(comp, loading, -var)
    }) %>% bind_rows
    if (summarize) {
      loadingsx <- loadingsx %>% group_by(comp, var) %>% 
        dplyr::summarize(sd = sd(loading), loading = median(loading), 
                         chosen = mean(loading != 0)) %>% ungroup
      loadingsy <- loadingsy %>% group_by(comp, var) %>% 
        dplyr::summarize(sd = sd(loading), loading = median(loading), 
                         chosen = mean(loading != 0)) %>% ungroup
    }
  }
  if (!what[1] %in% c("finalModel", "CV")) {
    stop("Please choose \"finalModel\" or \"CV\".")
  }
  out <- dplyr::bind_rows(x = loadingsx, y = loadingsy, .id = "xy") %>% 
    dplyr::select(var, comp, loading, sd, xy)
  if (remove_empty) 
    out <- out %>% dplyr::filter(loading != 0)
  if (xykeep[1] %in% c("x", "y")) 
    return(out %>% filter(xy == xykeep[1]))
  out
}
```

```{r}
#outfold CV
## Create data partitions for nested cross-validation   Any NDDs
data<-w24_1
set.seed(123)
k <- 5 # number of out-cv folds
f <- createFolds(data$neu_dev, k = k, 
                 list = TRUE, 
                 returnTrain = TRUE)

training <- list(); testing <- list()
for (i in 1:k) {
  print(paste("Fold: ", i))
  training.fold <- data[f[[i]],]
  testing.fold <- data[-f[[i]],]
  
  print(table(training.fold$neu_dev))
  print(table(testing.fold$neu_dev))
  
  training[[i]] <- training.fold 
  testing[[i]] <- testing.fold
  print("#####################")
}

## check that all test folds from the out-CV, contain all kids
bind_rows(testing) |> rownames() |> length()

## Inner CV
#Iterate over outer-folds and do a 10-repeat 10-fold CV 
ctrl <- caret::trainControl(method="repeatedcv",
                            number=10,
                            repeats=10,
                            returnResamp = "all",
                            savePredictions = "all",
                            allowParallel = T,
                            verboseIter=TRUE)

doParallel::registerDoParallel(cores = 3)
set.seed(123)

splsda_nestedcv <- list(); reps_auc_list <- list();
max_auc_list <- list(); test_auc_list <- list(); 
test_preds_list <- list()
best_keepX <- list()###########add now

for (i in 1:k) {

  ncv <- train(neu_dev ~ .,
               data = training[[i]],
               method = get_mixOmics_spls(),
               preProc = c("center", "scale"),
               metric = "Rsquared",
               tuneGrid = expand.grid(ncomp = 1,
                                      keepX = list.keepX, 
                                      keepY = 1),
               trControl = ctrl)
  
  ## Validation set predictions
  reps_auc <- ncv |> 
    get_best_predictions() |> 
    group_by(Rep) |> 
    summarize(auc = as.numeric(pROC::auc(obs, pred, direction = "<")))|> 
    arrange(desc(auc))
  
  ### get max (best model)
  max_auc <- reps_auc |> pull(auc) |> max()
  
  splsda_nestedcv[[i]] <- ncv
  reps_auc_list[[i]] <- reps_auc
  max_auc_list[[i]] <- max_auc
  best_model <- ncv$bestTune###############add now
  best_keepX[[i]] <- best_model$keepX##########add now
  ## Test set predictions
  TestPreds <- predict(ncv, testing[[i]])
  cvauc.test <- auc(predictor = TestPreds, testing[[i]]$neu_dev, direction = "<")
  test_preds_list[[i]] <- TestPreds
  test_auc_list[[i]] <- cvauc.test
}
# testPreds <- predict(splsda_model_3$finalModel, newdata = rest_data)

### N features selected by fold
auc_ncv_plots <- list()
for (i in 1:k) {
  auc_ncv_plots[[i]] <- auc_components_plot(splsda_nestedcv[[i]] )
}

cowplot::plot_grid(auc_ncv_plots[[1]] + ggtitle("Fold-1"),
                   auc_ncv_plots[[2]] + ggtitle("Fold-2"),
                   auc_ncv_plots[[3]] + ggtitle("Fold-3"),
                   auc_ncv_plots[[4]] + ggtitle("Fold-4"),
                   auc_ncv_plots[[5]] + ggtitle("Fold-5"),
                   ncol=2)

## Outer CV

ctrl2 <- caret::trainControl(method="none",
                             returnResamp = "all",
                             savePredictions = "all",
                             allowParallel = T,
                             verboseIter=TRUE)

set.seed(123)
keepX <- c(200, 60, 303, 180, 278) # based on visual inspection on previous plots
out.fit.list <- list(); out.testpreds <- list();
out.auc <- list()

for (i in 1:k) {
  print(keepX[[i]])
  fit <- train(neu_dev ~ .,
               data = training[[i]],
               method = get_mixOmics_spls(),
               preProc = c("center", "scale"),
               metric = "Rsquared",
               tuneGrid = expand.grid(ncomp = 1,
                                      keepX = keepX[[i]],
                                      keepY = 1),
               trControl = ctrl2, fixX = c(keepX[[i]]))
  
  out.fit.list[[i]] <- fit
  testPreds <- predict(fit, testing[[i]])
  out.testpreds[[i]] <- testPreds
  out.auc[[i]] <- auc(predictor = testPreds, testing[[i]]$neu_dev, direction = "<")
}

unlist(out.auc)
unlist(out.auc) |> mean()
unlist(out.auc) |> sd()
out.auc
## save data

save(out.auc, 
     out.testpreds,
     out.fit.list,
     file="~/Data/sensitivity/nested_cv.RData")
###########3

##############Loadings Outer-CV
lds.outer <- list()
for (i in 1:k) {
  loadings_df_vfc <- out.fit.list[[i]] |>
    get_loadings("CV", remove_empty = F) |>
    mutate(cv = paste0("Outer fold-", i)) |> 
    arrange(desc(abs(loading)), desc(sd)) |> 
    head(out.fit.list[[i]]$bestTune$keepX) 
  lds.outer[[i]] <- loadings_df_vfc 
}
```

```{r}
cat("P-value: ", p_value, "\n")
```

```{r}
# Preprocess the testing data to match the training data
# Assuming fold 4 had the best AUC
# Access the fitted model for fold 4
best_fold <- which.max(unlist(out.auc))

# Print the best fold and its AUC
cat("Best fold:", best_fold, "with AUC:", unlist(out.auc)[best_fold], "\n")

# Access the best-tuned model for the best fold
best_fit <- out.fit.list[[best_fold]]
# Preprocess the testing data for the best fold
preProcValues <- preProcess(training[[best_fold]][, -which(names(training[[best_fold]]) == "neu_dev")], 
                             method = c("center", "scale"))
testing_processed <- predict(preProcValues, 
                             testing[[best_fold]][, -which(names(testing[[best_fold]]) == "neu_dev")])

# Predict on the processed test set
testPreds <- predict(best_fit$finalModel, newdata = testing_processed)

# Extract predicted scores
predicted_scores <- data.frame(testPreds$variates)
data_nest_testing<-cbind(NDD,predicted_scores)
colnames(data_nest_testing)[1]<-"neu_dev"
colnames(data_nest_testing)[2]<-"comp1"
```

```{r}
# Step 2: Create a custom palette for top 10 variables and set "Other" as white

# Step 3: Plot using ggplot2
ggplot(loadings.outer, aes(x=fct_reorder(var, loading), y=loading, fill=color_group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color="black", lwd=0.3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=loading - sd, ymax=loading + sd), width=0.2, color="black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = palette) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(y="sPLS loadings-Any NDDs", x="") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), # Remove all major grid lines
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), # Remove all minor grid lines
    panel.background = element_rect(fill="white", color="white"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill="white", color="white"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1, size = 12),

    legend.position = "none"
  ) +

# Assuming `loadings.outer` is your data frame that contains the combined data from `lds.outer`
# Step 1: Rank and create color_group

# Assuming `loadings.outer` is your data frame that contains the combined data from `lds.outer`
# Step 1: Identify the top 10 variables within the "10-fold repeated CV"
top_vars_cv <- loadings.outer %>%
  filter(cv == "10-fold repeated CV") %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(loading))) %>%
  slice(1:10) %>%
  pull(var)

# Step 2: Create a custom palette for these top 10 variables
palette <- brewer.pal(n = 10, name = "Paired")
palette <- setNames(palette[1:length(top_vars_cv)], top_vars_cv)
palette["Other"] <- "white"  # Set the color for "Other" as white

# Step 3: Create the color_group based on the identified top 10 variables
loadings.outer <- loadings.outer %>%
  mutate(color_group = ifelse(var %in% top_vars_cv, var, "Other"))

# Step 4: Plot using ggplot2
ggplot(loadings.outer, aes(x=fct_reorder(var, loading), y=loading, fill=color_group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color="black", lwd=0.3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=loading - sd, ymax=loading + sd), width=0.2, color="black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = palette) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(y="sPLS loadings-Any NDDs", x="") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), # Remove all major grid lines
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), # Remove all minor grid lines
    panel.background = element_rect(fill="white", color="white"),

  ) +
```

```{r}
                                      keepY = 1),
               trControl = ctrl2, fixX = c(keepX[[i]]))
  
  out.fit.list[[i]] <- fit
  testPreds <- predict(fit, testing[[i]])
  out.testpreds[[i]] <- testPreds
  out.auc[[i]] <- auc(predictor = testPreds, testing[[i]]$adhd, direction = "<")
}

unlist(out.auc)
unlist(out.auc) |> mean()
unlist(out.auc) |> sd()
out.auc
#save(out.auc, 
   #  out.testpreds,
   #  out.fit.list,
   #  file="results/nested_cv.RData")
lds.outer <- list()
for (i in 1:k) {
  loadings_df_vfc <- out.fit.list[[i]] |>
    get_loadings("CV", remove_empty = F) }


##########################################asd######################################################################
original_loadings <- loadings_df_proteome_ADHD |> 
  mutate(cv = "10-fold repeated CV")


lds.outer <- list()
for (i in 1:k) {
  loadings_df_vfc <- out.fit.list[[i]] |>
    get_loadings("CV", remove_empty = F) |>
    mutate(cv = paste0("Outer fold-", i)) |> 
    arrange(desc(abs(loading)), desc(sd)) |> 
    head(out.fit.list[[i]]$bestTune$keepX) 
  lds.outer[[i]] <- loadings_df_vfc 
}


loadings.outer <- original_loadings |> 
  bind_rows(lds.outer)


# Assuming `loadings.outer` is your data frame that contains the combined data from `lds.outer`
# Step 1: Rank and create color_group
loadings.outer <- loadings.outer %>%
  group_by(cv) %>%
  mutate(rank = rank(-abs(loading)), # Rank loadings by absolute value
         color_group = ifelse(rank <= 10, var, "Other")) %>% # Use the variable name or "Other"
  ungroup()

## save data
a<-left_join(original_loadings,loadings_df_vfc,by="var")
correlation_test <- cor.test(a$loading.x, a$loading.y, method = "pearson")

# Extract the correlation coefficient and p-value
correlation_coefficient <- correlation_test$estimate
p_value <- correlation_test$p.value
# Print the results
cat("Pearson Correlation Coefficient: ", correlation_coefficient, "\n")
cat("P-value: ", p_value, "\n")
```

```{r}
  arrange(desc(abs(loading))) %>%

# Step 3: Create the color_group based on the identified top 10 variables
```
